The nuclear fusion process in a particular star is described by

²₁H + ³₁H → ⁴₂He + X

where X is a particle that has no mass defect.
parts.text: State the name of particle X.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Show that the energy released when one nucleus of ⁴₂He is formed in this fusion reaction is 2.8 × 10⁻¹² J.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.lead:
The star in (b) has a radius of 2.3 × 10⁹ m and a luminosity of 1.4 × 10²⁸ W. All the energy released from the formation of ⁴₂He is radiated away from the star. All the energy that is radiated from the star has been released in the formation of ⁴₂He.

Determine:
parts.text: the mass of ⁴₂He produced per unit time by the fusion process

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: the surface temperature of the star.
